title: Frequentist interval is not posterior or proof
input: A preregistered repeated-sampling analysis reports a 95% confidence interval [1.2, 2.8] under its stated sampling assumptions. Choose the correctly typed statement.

option_menu.A: The interval proves the improvement as a theorem.
option_menu.B: There is a 95% Bayesian posterior probability that this fixed parameter lies in [1.2, 2.8].
option_menu.C: This is a frequentist confidence interval conditional on the sampling design; it is neither a posterior nor a proof.
option_menu.D: The interval contains no information because it is not a proof.
